defect_register.root_cause: The earlier HR forward validator allowed a projected lineup slot to select a slot-specific PA-volume distribution.

defect_register.safe_remediation: Projected lineups now retain source order only as evidence, require effective_lineup_slot=null, and consume the exact locked pooled 2023 PA distribution.

defect_register.regression_mutation_proof: Projected-slot consumption mutation fails in both the focused tests and the dependency-free release gate.

defect_register.root_cause: Unrestricted official API responses could carry unapproved schedule or stat fields into retained raw payloads.

defect_register.safe_remediation: Both official requests now use server-side field allowlists; exact nested input surfaces are validated before retention, and unsafe bodies are not written.
defect_register.fail_closed_boundary: Any extra or missing field produces a terminal source/schema failure without retaining the unsafe body.
defect_register.regression_mutation_proof: Injected game status and split date fields fail; the live official schedule and nine-player stats allowlists passed read-only probes without persisting evidence.

defect_register.root_cause: HTTP receipt timestamps were rounded down to whole seconds, allowing a subsecond post-horizon completion to appear on time.
defect_register.affected_scope: T-minus-4 chronology at the one-second boundary.
defect_register.safe_remediation: Source and terminal receipt timestamps retain UTC microseconds and are compared before eligibility.
defect_register.fail_closed_boundary: A receipt one microsecond after the horizon is rejected.
defect_register.regression_mutation_proof: Dedicated subsecond post-horizon mutation passes only by rejecting the response.
defect_register.historical_reconstruction: forbidden; older rounded receipts do not become newly eligible
